t: A low-cost USB radio dongle that lets your computer listen across the airwaves.
steps: Buy the V4 from a listed reseller such as SparkFun or The Pi Hut, or pick the newer V4L from the RTL-SDR Blog store.
Avoid cheap marketplace listings, as many fake V4 units exist.
Follow the V4 user guide to install the RTL-SDR Blog drivers for your computer.
Plug in the dongle and attach the dipole antenna near a window.
Tune to a local FM station and listen.
Next try a free ADS-B app to track planes.
meta: Open Code. From $37.95. A few stores.
